verdict.rationale: Missive ships its own MCP server, so external AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can act on conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts in natural language (e.g. "summarize your inbox and draft replies"). It also has a built-in AI assistant that runs long sessions, creates drafts, triages conversations and answers how-to questions from the docs. missing for 10: detailed docs on which in-app actions the built-in assistant can perform from natural-language commands, independent or hands-on corroboration, and native AI without a bring-your-own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini key.
